title: wildmat: extract to core crate
description:
## What
Move wildmat_match() and matches_wildmat() from crates/reader/src/session/commands/list.rs to crates/core/src/wildmat.rs; update reader to import from core. Pure refactor — no semantic change.

## Algorithm
1. Read crates/reader/src/session/commands/list.rs to copy exact wildmat_match(text: &[u8], pattern: &[u8]) -> bool and matches_wildmat(name: &str, pattern: &str) -> bool
2. Create crates/core/src/wildmat.rs with those two functions; wildmat_match stays private (pub(crate)), matches_wildmat is pub
3. Add 'pub mod wildmat;' to crates/core/src/lib.rs
4. In crates/reader/src/session/commands/list.rs: remove local definitions, add 'use stoa_core::wildmat::matches_wildmat;'
5. Run cargo test -p stoa-core -p stoa-reader to verify no regressions

## Defensive programming rules
- Pure refactor: copy bytes exactly, do not modify logic
- Do not add or change any behavior
- Confirm all existing list.rs wildmat tests still pass after move
- No unwrap() — function has no error paths

## Agent team
Standard: Agent R (read list.rs + core/lib.rs), Agent I (copy + rewire), Agent V (cargo test -p stoa-reader -p stoa-core + clippy)

## Tests
No new tests. Existing tests in reader for matches_wildmat serve as correctness oracle.
